title: Beach Blessing | KEY.co
description_expanded: Beyond the interior's plush comforts, this vacation rental invites you to indulge in a unique outdoor experience. Revel in the joy of preparing meals on the grill and dining under the stars, or take advantage of the proximity to the beach and the community pool for a day filled with sun, swimming, and relaxation. For those who cherish luxury and convenience, the master bathroom's rain shower offers a spa-like retreat, promising moments of blissful tranquility. This property not only promises a stay filled with luxury and comfort but also provides a pet-friendly environment, ensuring that every member of your family can partake in the coastal bliss. Embark on a journey to this coastal paradise and let it be the backdrop to creating memories that will last a lifetime. Nestled just steps away from the pristine sands, this luxurious beachfront haven is the epitome of modern elegance melded with the serene ambiance of coastal living. Its brand-new construction ensures guests are enveloped in the latest comforts and styles, making it an ideal escape for those seeking a blend of relaxation and sophistication. The residence boasts three generously sized bedrooms and two and a half contemporary bathrooms, along with an array of top-notch amenities tailored for an unforgettable beach vacation. From the sun-drenched, open-plan living space to the state-of-the-art kitchen equipped with high-end appliances, every detail has been meticulously curated to cater to your every need and desire.
